brief: Holds a piece of conditional code, the Ring expression of a W or WXT condition, and rewrites it to its basic form.
detail: The code is written with the keywords @i and This[@i], or with friendlier words such as @CurrentItem, @NextItem and @PreviousItem. Transpiled turns the friendly words into the basic forms; ExecutableSection says over which positions of a list the code can run without reading outside it.
